messages:
Anya: quick sync: for onprem bootstrap resume, do we want gossip-based resume (peers share offsets) or pull-based resume (node fetches index from a trusted mirror)? thinking about airgapped & intermittent links.
Kevin: @Anya +1 to evaluating both. Gossip: simpler offline recovery, tolerant to partial connectivity, but more surface for sprawl and harder to authenticate unless signed manifests everywhere. Pull: stronger auth, easier rate control, but needs a reachable mirror + resume tokens.
Sylvie: Operator perspective: pull lets us throttle and audit requests. Also easier to integrate with existing operator controller code. But in airgap, mirror is often a bastion box; pulling from it is fine only if we can pin certs.
deploy-bot: Canary: started a job deploying 'resume-protocol-experiment' to staging cluster-3 (job id 2026).
Liam: Bandwidth/backoff question: any thoughts on exponential backoff vs token-leased windows? If node retries aggressively it can hammer the bastion when many nodes come back.
Anya: @Liam good point. What about a lease token model: node obtains a resume lease (duration + bandwidth cap) then pulls chunks. If lease unavailable, fallback to gossip delta for small fixes.
Sylvie: Lease model looks good. Small config snippet for operator helm values I sketched: ```yaml
resumeLease:
  enabled: true
  maxBytes: 100MB
  ttl: 5m
``` Can add jittered retry and cluster-wide queue.
Arnaud: Hybrid idea: initial seed via removable media (USB) or OCI side-load, then use gossip to find peers and pull deltas from local aggregator. Reduces load on central bastion.
Kevin: Security: manifests must be signed and include content-length and chunk checksums. For gossip we need signed compact manifests to avoid MITM. Also correlate resume tokens to operator-level audit logs.
Anya: Decision proposal: implement pull-first with resume-lease + jittered backoff, fallback to gossip for tiny deltas and when mirror is unreachable. We'll add signed compact manifests and operator helm flags. Next: write RFC to formalize operator API & leak-proofing. Thoughts?
Liam: :thumbsup: agree. Add metrics: resume_attempts, lease_grants, lease_denials, gossip_fallbacks.
Sylvie: I'll draft helm values and operator flow. Want a small POC by EOW. Assigning to @Sylvie + @Kevin for manifest/signing details.
Anya: Thanks all — moving to RFC draft. (closing thread) :rocket:
